title: 好吃的

explanations.1: It is a verb meaning 'go', used with '商店' to indicate going to the store.
explanations.2: It is a location noun meaning 'inside', indicating the fruits are inside the store.
explanations.3: It is a conjunction meaning 'and', connecting the two fruits apples and bananas.
explanations.4: It is an adjective meaning 'delicious', describing the apples.
explanations.5: It is a verb meaning 'cook', used with '饭' to indicate cooking a meal.
explanations.6: It is a pronoun meaning 'we', showing who eats lunch together.
explanations.7: It is a verb meaning 'drink', used with '牛奶' to indicate drinking milk.
explanations.8: It is an adjective meaning 'cold', describing the milk.
explanations.9: It is a time word meaning 'evening', indicating when the eating happens.
explanations.10: It is an adjective meaning 'cheap', describing the noodles.
explanations.11: It is a measure word, required with number '一' to count eggs.
explanations.12: It is an adjective meaning 'big', describing the egg.

translation: I went to the store this morning. There were many fruits inside the store. I bought apples and bananas. Apples are delicious, and bananas are also delicious. Mom cooks at home. At noon we eat rice and dishes. In the afternoon I drink milk. The milk is cold. In the evening I eat noodles. The noodles are cheap. I ate an egg. The egg is big. I am very happy.
